doc: Drafted by the Director on 2026-11-21 for the four directions in the owner's sheet that have no spoken line, and the two blank place names. NOT approved by the owner: shown in the game tonight with draft: true and listed as Calls in REPORT. Each names the direction row it stands for (the row's text in dialog.owner.json).

lines.for_direction: Mulroney through radio tells to keep him busy, reinforcements are on the way
lines.t: Keep it busy! Nobody plays hero. I'm two minutes out with everybody we got!

lines.for_direction: Scared cop tries to engage with Rivet and requests to turn off its power system for anyone safety
lines.t: Sir... unit... for everyone's safety, power down your system. Please. Just power down.

lines.for_direction: Rivet questions why he should do that, thinks they destroyed the factory and now they want to kill him to clear evidence
lines.t: Power down? So you can finish it? You blew the plant and now you clean up the witness!

lines.for_direction: Dale comes closer, telling they are here to help him, that he understand the loss
lines.t: We're here to help you, Rivet. I understand the loss. I really do.
